pdf.body1_1: This report consolidates the strategic and operational results obtained during the Proof of Value (PoV) of the Stellar Cyber Open XDR platform, executed in the environment of {client}. The primary objective was to validate the advanced capabilities of unified visibility, intelligent event correlation, and incident response automation in a real scenario, faithfully reproducing the client's technological ecosystem and focusing on simulating the use cases discussed in the alignment meeting
pdf.body1_2: The validation and monitoring activities spanned from {startDate} to {endDate}. Throughout this evaluation cycle, {{connCount|# strategic data source was|# strategic data sources were}} successfully integrated. The centralization of these logs allowed the platform to apply its AI engines, resulting in the identification and grouping of {{caseCount|# security case|# security cases}}. This volume translated into a coverage of {mitrePct}% of the tactics mapped by the global MITRE ATT&CK® Enterprise framework{noiseClause}

pdf.body6_1: The Stellar Cyber platform demonstrated a unified interface with clear visualization of risk-prioritized alerts. The investigations panel allows analysts to navigate from alert to raw event in a few clicks, significantly reducing Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) and Mean Time to Respond (MTTR).
pdf.step1action: Alert automatically generated by the platform
pdf.step2action: Analyst reviews alert and correlated context
pdf.step4action: Host isolation or IP blocking via integration
pdf.step6action: Case closed with timeline and RCA recorded
pdf.body6_3: The platform supports response automation via configurable playbooks (native SOAR), enabling automatic actions such as: alert enrichment with threat intelligence, team notifications, endpoint isolation and malicious IP blocking — reducing the SOC operational burden.
pdf.ben1impact: Data correlation across the entire attack surface in a single platform
pdf.ben2impact: AI/ML prioritizes and groups alerts, reducing SOC operational noise
pdf.ben3impact: Centralized logs facilitate audits and regulatory requirements (GDPR, ISO 27001)
pdf.ben4impact: Cloud-native architecture scales automatically with environment growth
pdf.ben5impact: One platform replaces multiple specialized tools and teams
pdf.noRisks: No risks identified during the evaluation period.

pdf.volIntro: Daily data volume of the tenant in the period, as recorded by the platform for volume licensing (data stored after enrichment and compression).
pdf.volNoData: No licensing volume data in the PoV period.
pdf.volRecommendedNote: Covers the sustained 3-day peak ({from}–{to}) without a Warning.
pdf.volShortPeriod: Recommendation based on {n} days of data. 30 days of data are recommended.
pdf.volDescIntro: With a {l}/day volume license, the platform tolerates up to {t} per day (110%). Beyond that:
pdf.volDescWarning: • If the daily volume stays above {t} on 3 consecutive days, the platform issues a Warning: a removable banner appears in the UI.
pdf.volDescViolation: • If it stays above {t} for 7 consecutive days, it enters Violation: the banner can no longer be removed and the account admin receives an email.
pdf.volDescOoc: • If it stays above {t} for 21 consecutive days (7 to enter Violation + 14 in Violation), the license is Out of Compliance: services cease and a prorated invoice is issued.
pdf.minEntitiesNote: Lowest daily count in the period
pdf.maxEntitiesNote: Highest daily count in the period (peak)
pdf.entitiesDaysNote: {{days|# day|# days}} in the period · {zero} with a count of 0
pdf.licHowCounted: Licensed asset = a unique device (internal IP) or unique user (email) observed in the day.
pdf.licNoData: No asset data in the PoV period.
pdf.licRuleWarning: Above 110% of the limit on each of 3 consecutive days
pdf.licRuleViolation: Above 110% of the limit on each of 7 consecutive days
pdf.licRuleOoc: Above 110% of the limit for 21 consecutive days (7 to enter Violation + 14 in Violation)
pdf.licResWarning: Removable banner in the UI. Clears after 3 consecutive days at or below 110%.
pdf.licResViolation: Non-removable banner and email to the account admin. Clears after 7 consecutive days at or below 110%.
pdf.licResOoc: Services cease and a prorated invoice covers the gap between average usage since the first Violation and the license.
pdf.licInsufficient: Insufficient period to recommend ({n} of {d} days)
pdf.licRecommendedNote: Covers the sustained 3-day peak ({from}–{to}) without a Warning.
pdf.licShortPeriod: Recommendation based on {n} days of data. 30 days of asset discovery are recommended.
pdf.licDescIntro: With {l} asset licenses, the platform tolerates up to {t} assets per day (110%). Beyond that:
pdf.licDescWarning: • If the daily count stays above {t} assets on 3 consecutive days, the platform issues a Warning: a removable banner appears in the UI.
pdf.licDescViolation: • If it stays above {t} assets for 7 consecutive days, it enters Violation: the banner can no longer be removed and the account admin receives an email.
pdf.licDescOoc: • If it stays above {t} assets for 21 consecutive days (7 to enter Violation + 14 in Violation), the license is Out of Compliance: services cease and a prorated invoice is issued.

pdf.body6_2: Stellar Cyber's built-in SOAR capabilities enable automated triage, enrichment and response playbooks that reduce analyst fatigue and accelerate containment.

pdf.qb4: • Reduced tool sprawl and operational complexity.
